extension.summary: Friendly TV live channels, guide and on-demand for Kodi
extension.description:
Watch the live channel lineup, the programme guide and the on-demand catalogue from your own Friendly TV subscription, playing back through InputStream Adaptive with Widevine DRM.
Friendly TV runs on Revlet, and this addon speaks the same private endpoints as the web player at watch.frndlytv.com. Sign in with the email address and password you already use.
Features: * Live TV: every channel in your lineup, each showing what is on right now * Guide: a day of schedule per channel * The service's own Home, Movies, TV and My Stuff pages * Widevine playback through InputStream Adaptive, with no licence proxy -- Friendly TV's licence server speaks raw Widevine, so Kodi talks to it directly * Concurrent-stream slots are released when playback stops, so the account does not lock itself out * Optional IPTV Manager integration, putting the lineup and guide in Kodi's own TV section
Your subscription, your account, your lineup. Nothing is proxied through a third party.
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Friendly Technologies or Frndly TV. This addon uses private, undocumented endpoints; use it with your own subscription.
extension.news: 2026.9.1 - First release - Live TV, the guide, and the service's own Home/Movies/TV/My Stuff pages. - Playback is Widevine DASH through InputStream Adaptive. Friendly TV's licence server takes a raw Widevine challenge and answers with raw licence bytes, which is exactly what ISA speaks, so there is no licence proxy in this addon and nothing listening on localhost. - Stream slots are handed back when playback stops. Friendly TV counts concurrent streams and only frees one when its poll key is posted back, so a client that never does locks the account out of its own subscription. - Optional IPTV Manager integration for Kodi's TV section.
